# vnIIc attribution

The palette, Floyd-Steinberg quantization approach, HGR scanline addressing,
and paired-byte color packing in `pc/hires.cs` are adapted from `server.js` in
vnIIc, Copyright (c) 2020 Joshua Bell, distributed under the MIT license copied
verbatim in LICENSE beside this notice.

Source supplied by the user: `vnIIc-master.zip`, SHA-256
`3660e349352d7e655fd236543c18e0f4eb737985b1e3582d234895db154aa149`.
Upstream project: https://github.com/a2stuff/vnIIc

The native Windows host, capture/preview lifecycle, bootstrap configuration,
and A2HR receiver are additions. A2HR uses a distinct versioned request and a
checksummed, stoppable response protocol; it is not wire-compatible with the
original vnIIc client or the A2MC receiver. Upstream HTML/JavaScript is not loaded
or executed by the launcher. The original ZIP is not a runtime dependency.
